verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a compliance/security SaaS platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis. First-party docs show two documented ways to connect an agent to the Oneleet MCP server. One is a keyless OAuth browser login with workspace selection, where the assistant acts with the user's role permissions. The other uses scoped service keys built for MCP and agent automation, and a probe confirms the MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: any documentation of which tools or actions the MCP server exposes, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the connection works.
